$comment: Everything this repo takes from vcpkg, at the versions the vcpkg commit in scripts/vcpkg.ts fixes. One feature per getter, so a machine that only compiles shaders never builds a codec.

codecs.description: `bun run get:codecs`: libavif and libjxl, and aom, dav1d, sharpyuv, highway, brotli and lcms2 under them, static. pkgconf is how the getter reads the link line back out.

shaders.description: `bun run get:slangc`: the Slang compiler, which vcpkg downloads prebuilt rather than building.
